_provenance.notes: Historical database cataloging early Alaska salmon cannery lithograph labels (1878-1960). In the 19th and early 20th century, salmon canneries used colorful stone-lithographed paper labels featuring bears, Native motifs, ships, and heraldic crests to market canned Alaska salmon across North America and Europe. Grades were strictly segregated: Red Salmon (Sockeye) commanded top prices, Medium Red (Coho/Pink) mid-tier, and Chum/Dog Salmon lowest.

historic_salmon_grades.target_market: UK & US East Coast luxury grocers
